topic: Capstone Project Discovery, Research Synthesis, and Problem Framing
learningObjectives: Synthesize user research findings into actionable insights.
Identify and prioritize the core user problem for a capstone project.
Create a clear problem statement and measurable design goals.

activities.title: Research Insight Map
activities.instruction: Connect research observations to recurring themes and user needs.

content.concept: Research synthesis groups observations into patterns, themes, and actionable insights.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

items.label: Observation
items.description: A user repeatedly abandons the checkout process when asked to enter lengthy information.

items.label: Pattern
items.description: Users experience friction when tasks require unnecessary manual input.

items.label: User Need
items.description: Users need a faster and simpler way to complete checkout.

items.label: Insight
items.description: Reducing unnecessary input can improve task completion and perceived ease of use.

items.label: Opportunity
items.description: Explore autofill, saved information, or progressive disclosure.

activities.title: Problem Framing
activities.instruction: Arrange the elements into a focused problem statement.

content.concept: A strong problem statement identifies the target user, their need, and the context or challenge.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Insight Prioritizer
activities.instruction: Adjust the impact level of each insight and identify which problems deserve greater design attention.

content.concept: Prioritization helps teams focus design effort on problems with meaningful user impact.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

scenarios.insight: Users occasionally struggle to find a secondary settings option.
Users frequently abandon the main task because they cannot understand the next step.
Users report that a decorative animation feels slightly distracting.

activities.title: Design Goal Builder
activities.instruction: Select measurable goals that directly respond to the defined user problem.

content.concept: Design goals translate user problems into specific outcomes the solution should achieve.
